description:
Cast Accursed Centaur from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
When Accursed Centaur enters, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
When Accursed Centaur dies, Mortuary and Sifa Grent trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Accursed Centaur from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Sifa Grent trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.
